drugs.name: Omalizumab
drugs.mechanism: Monoclonal antibody against IgE, so less IgE arms the high-affinity receptors on mast cells that allergens cross-link to release histamine
drugs.use: Specialist-started add-on for severe allergic (IgE-mediated) asthma that stays uncontrolled despite adherence, good inhaler technique and a confirmed diagnosis

drugs.name: Mepolizumab / reslizumab
drugs.mechanism: Monoclonal antibodies against IL-5, the cytokine that recruits eosinophils into the airway
drugs.use: Specialist-started add-on for severe eosinophil-driven asthma that stays uncontrolled despite adherence, good inhaler technique and a confirmed diagnosis

drugs.name: Heliox
drugs.mechanism: Helium mixed with oxygen is less dense than air, so it gets past severely narrowed, swollen airways with less resistance
drugs.use: Status asthmaticus not responding to IV steroids, inhaled beta-2 agonists and IV magnesium, as a bridge while CPAP/BiPAP or intubation is considered

drugs.name: Systemic corticosteroids (prednisone)
drugs.adverseEffects: Suppress host defenses, raising the risk of invasive aspergillosis in immunocompromised patients; a cause of metabolic alkalosis
drugs.use: IV in status asthmaticus; oral, with albuterol, for a COPD exacerbation; first line for progressive sarcoidosis; desquamative interstitial pneumonia and eosinophilic pneumonias

drugs.name: Supplemental O2
drugs.adverseEffects: In a chronic CO2 retainer, too much can push PaCO2 higher and depress breathing (taught as loss of hypoxic drive), so titrate to a modest saturation
drugs.use: The one COPD therapy proven to improve mortality and survival; in an exacerbation, give only enough to correct the hypoxemia
